allocation_type: new one-shot successor after allocation 01 pre-candidate STOP; not a retry of launched candidate data
hypothesis: With a corrected runner that reads the frozen nested environment schema, OrbStack reproduces the retained deterministic host candidate bytes exactly and the independent raw-only auditor reconstructs all rows with zero errors.
treatment: Verify this recovery freeze, its parent freeze, source hashes, baseline-output hash and exact local image. Create both fresh isolated containers before starting either. Invoke candidate once, then auditor once only after candidate exit 0 and raw output exists. Store results under the distinct results/replication-02 path.

decision_gate.auditor_invocations: 1 only after candidate exit 0 and raw output exists
decision_gate.replication_pass_if: candidate raw SHA-256 equals retained host output SHA-256 and independent auditor errors are empty
decision_gate.visual_t1_hold_if: any block has fewer than eight independent centers

H_T_D_C_U.H: Exact byte reproduction of the known host geometry enumeration, independently reconstructed from the container raw output.
H_T_D_C_U.T: Separate candidate/auditor OrbStack containers, each at most once; no model fit and no retry. Allocation 01 had zero candidate/auditor/container invocations.
H_T_D_C_U.D: REPLICATION_PASS_WITH_GEOMETRY_HOLD iff the candidate bytes reproduce the host output, the independent audit is clean, and any block remains below eight eligible independent sites.
H_T_D_C_U.C: A deterministic finite geometry enumeration only; this does not estimate model behavior.
H_T_D_C_U.U: No visual efficacy, real GUI, task effect, calibration, safety, authority, or spatial-autocorrelation claim. A larger canvas/support design needs a new scientific protocol.
